title: Attachment upload — valid file succeeds with sanitized metadata
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/attachments accepts an allowlisted file type within size limits, stores with random storage key, sanitizes filename, and audits the upload.
preconditions: Operator session; asset with attachments enabled; media volume/minio running.
test_data: valid PNG (<1MB) named '../../../evil pic.png'; valid PDF
steps: Upload the PNG via multipart POST.
Verify response metadata (uuid, sanitized filename, content_type, size, uploaded_by/at).
Verify audit event for upload exists.
Verify stored filename/storage_key contains no path traversal segments.
expected_result: 201 with metadata; filename sanitized (no traversal, safe chars); storage key random/opaque; audit event with actor + target; direct storage URL never exposed (download only via authorized endpoint).

title: Attachment upload validation — type, signature, size rejection
objective: Verify uploads are rejected on disallowed extension, MIME/content-signature mismatch, and oversize, with proper status codes and no partial storage.
test_data: (a) .exe file; (b) .png extension with executable content (signature mismatch); (c) file exceeding configured limit (default 10MB); (d) SVG with embedded script if SVG not allowlisted
steps: Attempt each upload; record status/error envelope.
Verify no Attachment row or stored object remains for rejected uploads.
expected_result: (a)/(b) 400 or 415 with user-safe code; (c) 413; (d) rejected or sanitized per documented policy; rejections leak no server paths; no orphaned files/rows; attempts audited if documented.

title: Attachment download authorization — no direct URLs, scope enforced
objective: Verify downloads flow only through the authorized backend endpoint; unauthenticated → 401, out-of-scope → 404, and no direct storage URL is reachable.
preconditions: Asset with attachment in dept B; users: no session, dept-A operator, dept-B operator, auditor.
test_data: attachment download URL; guessed storage key URL (from response metadata)
steps: GET download endpoint without session → expect 401.
GET as dept-A operator → expect 404 (no existence leak).
GET as dept-B operator → 200 with correct content + Content-Disposition.
Attempt direct storage URL access (if resolvable) → must not be publicly served.
expected_result: All access controlled per scope; correct bytes returned for authorized users; time-limited/authorized endpoint only (D-04); download audited.

title: Attachment replace/remove audited; documents tab UX
objective: Verify DELETE /assets/:uuid/attachments/:uuid removes per policy (with audit event) and the /assets/[id]/documents UI lists, uploads, downloads, and removes attachments with correct states.
test_data: delete one attachment; upload one via UI
steps: DELETE one attachment via API; verify removal + audit event.
Open documents tab in UI; verify list matches API; upload a file via UI; verify progress + success only after server confirm.
Verify remove action uses confirmation dialog naming the file.
expected_result: Delete audited with actor/timestamp; removed attachment no longer downloadable (404); UI states (loading/empty/error) per design; destructive confirmation present; employee role cannot delete others' attachments if policy restricts (verify documented behavior).

title: Notes — create with author + timestamp, visibility permissions
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/notes creates a note with author and UTC timestamp, visible on the asset to permitted users, hidden where policy restricts.
preconditions: Operator session; asset visible to operator + auditor.
test_data: note body with Unicode + markup-like text 'bold'
steps: POST note; verify response (author, created_at UTC, body stored as text).
Fetch asset activity/notes as operator and auditor; verify visibility per policy.
Render note in UI; verify markup-like text displays as literal text (no HTML injection).
expected_result: Note persisted with author + timestamp; bodies rendered as escaped text; visibility matches permission policy; note creation audited/in activity feed per design.

title: Notes edit policy — append-only corrective notes (v1)
objective: Verify notes cannot be edited or deleted; corrections are new appended notes referencing context, preserving full history.
preconditions: Asset with an existing note by operator.
test_data: PATCH/DELETE attempts on the note; corrective follow-up note
steps: Attempt PATCH and DELETE on the note endpoint (or verify absence of such endpoints in OpenAPI).
Post a corrective note; verify both notes visible chronologically.
expected_result: Edit/delete not possible (405/404, no such routes in schema); original note immutable; corrective note appended with its own author/timestamp; feed ordering reverse-chronological with both entries intact.
